items.title_zh: “神奇小子”创立的公司推出 chestnut eGPU 扩展坞，车载 AI 浮点运算提高约 100 倍
items.title_en: Company founded by 'wonder boy' launches chestnut eGPU dock, boosting in-car AI compute by ~100x
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，乔治 · 霍茨（George Hotz）创办的自动驾驶技术公司 comma.ai 于 8 月 12 日推出 chestnut 外置 eGPU 扩展坞，售价为 249 美元 （现汇率约合 1,682 元人民币） ，真机套件（含 AMD Radeon RX 9060 8GB）售价为 799 美元 （现汇率约合 5,399 元人民币） 。 IT之家注：霍茨网名为 geohot，人称“神奇小子”，是一位美国传奇黑客、软件工程师与创业者。他在 17 岁时因全球首个成功破解 iPhone 而一战成名，随后又破解了索尼的 PlayStation 3。 霍茨于 2016 年创立自动驾驶技术公司 comma.ai （他于 2022 年 10 月底辞去 comma.ai 的首席执行官职务，并退出 OpenPilot 项目），目标通过开源和平价硬件将半自动驾驶辅助系统带入大众视野。 这款 chestnut 外置 eGPU 扩展坞主要为 comma four 提供额外推理算力，官方表示 comma four 搭配 chestnut 后，算力接近 Tesla HW4。 车载计算机运行 openpilot AI 模型时，功耗控制在约 10W，但模型规模扩大后，原有算力逐渐不足。Chestnut 通过外接 eGPU， 将 comma four 的功耗上限提高到约 100W。 公司…
items.summary_en: comma.ai, founded by George Hotz, launched the chestnut external eGPU dock on Aug 12, priced at $249, or $799 with an AMD Radeon RX 9060 8GB. It boosts the inference compute of the comma four to near Tesla HW4, with floating-point performance up to ~100x. Power draw increases from ~10W to ~100W. Hotz stepped down as CEO in 2022.
items.why_zh: 它用低成本外接GPU大幅提升车载AI算力，可能推动半自动驾驶普及。
items.why_en: It offers a low-cost way to significantly boost in-car AI compute, potentially accelerating the adoption of semi-autonomous driving.

items.title_zh: 上线DeepSeek Harness！“LobsterAI”“登录即领5000积分”活动延长至 8月底
items.title_en: LobsterAI Debuts DeepSeek Harness, Extends "Login for 5,000 Credits" Promotion to End of August

items.summary_en: LobsterAI has launched DeepSeek Harness and extended its "Login to Get 5,000 Credits" promotion to the end of August. Users can claim credits upon login. Further details about the credit usage and the Harness service have not been announced.
items.why_zh: 此活动延长有助于吸引更多用户体验 DeepSeek Harness，或提升该平台的用户活跃度。
items.why_en: The extended promotion may attract more users to try DeepSeek Harness and boost platform engagement.

items.title_zh: 当AI设计AI：是创新还是模仿？
items.title_en: When AI Designs AI: Innovation or Imitation?
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究LLM智能体设计复杂AI任务方法的能力，并与人类设计的方法进行对比。作者提出一种分析方法，从人类设计的方法中推导出任务特定的算法设计空间，将人类与智能体设计的方法映射到该空间，并在模块层面量化它们的算法差异。研究重点关注两个问题：智能体设计的方法表现如何，以及它们在算法设计上与人类方法有多大不同。这一研究有助于理解AI自主设计方法的本质是真正的创新还是对已有方法的模仿。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in LLM agents have made them increasingly capable of designing methods for complex AI tasks. This raises two central questions about agent-designed methods relative to human-designed methods: how well they perform, and how different their algorithmic designs are. To study these questions, this paper introduces an analysis that derives task-specific algorithmic design spaces from human-designed methods, maps both human- and agent-designed methods into these spaces, and quantifies their algorithmic differences at the module level. W…
items.why_zh: 该研究首次在算法设计空间层面系统量化AI设计方法与人类方法的差异，关乎AI自主创新能力的判断。
items.why_en: It systematically quantifies how agent-designed methods differ from human ones, shedding light on whether AI can truly innovate.

items.title_zh: 审计金融智能体的自我进化：能力提升、安全漂移与执行接口错配
items.title_en: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch
items.summary_zh: 该论文对自我进化金融智能体进行审计，发现其能力提升的同时可能带来安全漂移。研究者审计了SkillOpt、Agent Workflow Memory（AWM）和ReasoningBank三种方法，在模拟电子银行环境中使用匹配的良性获取轨迹、密封评估端点、执行接地检查和独立状态回放。以Qwen 3.7 Flash为例，SkillOpt将良性效用从0.741提升至0.837，但暴露于注入内容的可能性也有所上升。研究强调仅观察进化后准确率不足以判断学习行为是否保留原有正确行为与安全性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving agents turn experience into reusable skills, workflows, or memories, but post-evolution accuracy alone does not show whether learned behavior preserves previously correct behavior or security. We audit SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and ReasoningBank in simulated e-banking using matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay. On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raises benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837 while exposure to injected content rises from 0.820 t…
items.why_zh: 该研究率先揭示金融智能体自我进化中的安全风险，提示部署此类系统需谨慎评估。
items.why_en: It highlights security risks in self-evolving financial agents, urging caution in deployment.

items.title_zh: 通过程序搜索与持续抽象发现实现程序化内容元生成
items.title_en: Procedural Content Metageneration via Program Search and Continual Abstraction Discovery
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出利用大语言模型直接搜索程序化内容生成器，而非单个关卡。研究在《推箱子》《塞尔达》等四款游戏中展开，通过语言模型的变异和交叉逐步演化完整的Python生成器。作者引入“持续抽象发现”（CAD）方法，从高适应度程序中提取可复用基元并放入运行时辅助模块。实验采用2×2设计，对比CAD与固定手写领域知识的组合效果。该方法有望提升程序化内容生成的泛化能力与创作效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17947v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can generate executable programs, which makes it possible to search directly over procedural content generators rather than individual levels. We study this approach in Sokoban, Zelda, Dangerous Dave, and Lode Runner. Each run evolves complete Python generators through language-model mutation and crossover. We introduce Continual Abstraction Discovery, or CAD, which extracts reusable primitives from high-fitness programs into a run-specific helper module. A 2x2 experiment crosses CAD with access to a fixed hand-written domai…
items.why_zh: 它将LLM程序生成与演化搜索结合，为游戏内容自动生成提供新范式。
items.why_en: It combines LLM program generation with evolutionary search, offering a new paradigm for automated game content creation.

items.title_zh: QuantumNovelty：用于量子论文与专利的审稿式审查和可专利性筛选的技能编排语言代理
items.title_en: QuantumNovelty: A Skill-Orchestrating Language Agent for Referee-Style Review and Patentability Screening of Quantum Papers and Patents
items.summary_zh: QuantumNovelty 是一个开源的技能编排语言代理，能够生成量子计算论文、帕累托前沿候选路径和专利草案，并通过模拟审稿人和专利审查专家小组进行审查。其设计核心是增加一层确定性的审计与证伪门控，如严格的帕累托支配性检查，以确保结果可审计、可复现且成本透明。该工作探索了用同一类智能体既产生科学成果又审视成果的可能性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16900v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly produce quantum-science results; we ask whether the same agentic paradigm can also scrutinize them in an auditable, reproducible, and cost-transparent form. We present QuantumNovelty, an open-source skill-orchestrating language agent that both generates quantum-computing artifacts (papers, Pareto-front ansatz candidates, and patent drafts) and reviews them through simulated referee and patent-examiner panels. Its design contribution is an audit-and-falsify layer of deterministic gates -- strict Pareto dominati…
items.why_zh: 它首次让语言代理同时扮演量子科研的“创造者”和“审查者”，有助于建立可审计的AI科研闭环。
items.why_en: For the first time, a language agent both produces and audits quantum-science outputs, supporting auditable AI-driven research.

items.title_zh: LLM Odyssey：基于游戏的教学平台，教授LLM工程概念
items.title_en: WIP: LLM Odyssey: A Game-Based Platform for Teaching LLM Engineering Concepts
items.summary_zh: 这篇工作进展论文介绍了一个名为 LLM Odyssey 的开源浏览器端严肃游戏平台，包含13个互动游戏，用于教授大语言模型工程概念。平台覆盖分词、Transformer架构、提示工程、检索增强生成（RAG）和生产部署等主题，这些主题在现有计算机科学课程中往往覆盖不足。与只针对单一概念的工具不同，该平台提供了教学脚手架和结构化学习路径，帮助学习者循序渐进掌握LLM工程知识。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16924v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work-in-progress (WIP) innovative practice category paper presents LLM Odyssey, an open source, browser-based serious gaming platform comprising 13 interactive games for teaching Large Language Model (LLM) engineering concepts. Topics such as tokenization, transformer architecture, prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and production deployment are underrepresented in computer science curricula. Existing interactive tools address individual concepts but lack pedagogical scaffolding or structured learning pathways. LLM O…
items.why_zh: 该平台以游戏化方式弥补LLM工程教育空缺，有望成为相关课程的重要补充。
items.why_en: It fills an educational gap in LLM engineering with a game-based, scaffolded approach.

items.title_zh: 鲁棒非线性输出调节中的非自适应学习
items.title_en: Nonadaptive Learning in Robust Nonlinear Output Regulation
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究一般非线性系统在输出反馈环境下、具有任意高相对度时的鲁棒非自适应调节问题。作者提出一种非自适应设计，将输入驱动滤波器与通用内模以及递归反步控制律相结合，从而把调节问题转化为增广误差系统的鲁棒输入-状态镇定。与自适应方法不同，该方法不依赖线性参数化回归量，也无需构造李雅普诺夫函数，简化了设计过程。该成果对高相对度非线性系统的鲁棒控制具有理论意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17262v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper considers robust nonadaptive regulation for general nonlinear systems in an output-feedback setting with arbitrarily high relative degree. We develop a nonadaptive design that combines an input-driven filter and a generic internal model with a recursive backstepping law, thereby recasting the regulation problem as the robust input-to-state stabilization of an augmented error system. Unlike adaptive schemes, the proposed method does not rely on linearly parameterized regressors and does not require the construction of Lyapunov functio…
items.why_zh: 该研究为高相对度非线性系统提供了一种更简洁的非自适应控制方案，有望降低设计与实现难度。
items.why_en: It offers a simpler nonadaptive control approach for high-relative-degree nonlinear systems, potentially easing implementation.

items.title_zh: tinyDSM：面向资源受限的微型机器人技能建模与开发框架
items.title_en: tinyDSM: A Framework for Skill Modeling and Development for Resource-Constrained Millirobots
items.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦于厘米级等资源受限小型机器人的自主学习与适应问题。作者提出了tinyDSM框架，该框架将内在动机与基于适应度的评估相结合，通过强化学习算法引导智能体在整个生命周期内进行技能获取与调整。其核心思路是最大程度减少硬编码技能，同时鼓励新技能的开放式涌现。这种设计使小型机器人在有限计算和存储资源下仍能自主探索环境并持续学习。该研究为微型机器人实现终身学习能力提供了新的方法框架，有望拓展其在复杂环境中的应用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this study, we investigate developmental mechanisms that enable small, resource-constrained systems such as cm-sized millirobots to autonomously explore, learn, and adapt their capabilities throughout their lifespan. Reinforcement learning algorithms guide the agent's skill acquisition and adaptation through the interplay of our proposed tinyDSM, which integrates intrinsic motivation and fitness-based assessment. We strive for minimal, hard-wired skills while encouraging the open-ended development of new skills. A key emphasis in our approac…
items.why_zh: 为资源受限的微型机器人实现终身技能学习提供了轻量级框架。
items.why_en: Provides a lightweight framework for lifelong skill learning in resource-constrained millirobots.

items.title_zh: 聚合分数掩盖了什么：衡量商业LLM API迁移中的项目级回归
items.title_en: What Aggregate Scores Miss: Measuring Item-Level Regressions in Commercial LLM API Migrations
items.summary_zh: 软件系统在供应商停止支持旧版大语言模型时，需要迁移到新版本API，而迁移决策通常依赖聚合基准分数，但这一分数会将异构的项目级行为压缩成一个单一数字。该研究旨在测量聚合分数掩盖了什么。针对GPT-5.4到GPT-5.6 Sol产品序列的三次升级，研究人员对900个公共基准项目（涵盖研究生级知识、奥数、指令跟随）各查询50次。通过比较聚合指标与逐项目表现，揭示迁移过程中可能出现的性能回退。研究提醒依赖大模型API的开发者，在模型升级时应进行更细粒度的回归测试，而不能仅看平均分数。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17719v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Context: Software systems that depend on commercial large language model APIs must migrate to successor versions when vendors deprecate older models. Migration decisions typically rely on aggregate benchmark scores, which compress heterogeneous item-level behaviour into a single net figure. Objective: We measure what that compression conceals. Method: On three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence, we query 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad mathematics, instruction following) 50 times per…
items.why_zh: 提醒大模型API迁移时不应只看聚合分数，需关注项目级性能回退。
items.why_en: Highlights that aggregate scores can hide per-item performance drops during LLM API migrations.

items.title_zh: 现成技术用于自动目标检测与识别的比较研究
items.title_en: Comparative Study of Out-of-the-Box Technology for Automatic Target Detection and Recognition
items.summary_zh: 自动目标检测与识别（ATD/R）对军事决策支持和（半）自主作战至关重要。近期目标检测与人工智能的进展大幅提升了ATD/R的潜在性能，然而公开军事数据集的稀缺限制了这些系统的实际部署。本文探索利用公开可用的模型和民用数据集来在军事场景中实现合理性能，并对多种最先进模型进行了基准测试。该研究旨在评估现成技术能否在军事环境中达到可用水平，为数据缺乏的军事任务提供低门槛的替代路径。这对推动目标识别技术在军事领域的快速应用具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17917v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic Target Detection and Recognition (ATD/R) is critical for military decision support and (semi-)autonomous operations. Recent advances in object detection and artificial intelligence (AI) significantly boosted the potential performance of ATD/R. However, the scarcity of publicly available military datasets limits the application of these systems. As a solution, this paper explores the use of publicly available models and civilian datasets to achieve reasonable performance in military contexts. We benchmark several state-of-the-art model…
items.why_zh: 为军事目标识别在数据稀缺条件下利用公开技术提供了可行路径。
items.why_en: Opens a viable path for military ATD/R using off-the-shelf models amid data scarcity.

items.title_zh: LZ惩罚：一种基于信息论的自回归语言模型重复惩罚方法
items.title_en: LZ Penalty: An information-theoretic repetition penalty for autoregressive language models
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出LZ惩罚，一种专门用于减少自回归语言模型中退化重复的惩罚项，且该方法不会损失模型能力。该惩罚基于LZ77通用无损压缩算法的码长，利用预测-压缩对偶原理，在解码时相当于从去除高度可压缩信息后的残差分布中采样。实验表明，LZ惩罚可以使最先进的开源推理模型在减少重复文本生成的同时维持性能水平。这为语言模型生成质量优化提供了新的信息论手段，尤其适用于长文本生成任务。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2504.20131v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce the LZ penalty, a penalty specialized for reducing degenerate repetitions in autoregressive language models without loss of capability. The penalty is based on the codelengths in the LZ77 universal lossless compression algorithm. Through the lens of the prediction-compression duality, decoding the LZ penalty has the interpretation of sampling from the residual distribution after removing the information that is highly compressible. We demonstrate the LZ penalty enables state-of-the-art open-source reasoning models to operat…
items.why_zh: 提供了一种不损失能力的信息论重复惩罚方法，改善生成文本质量。
items.why_en: Offers an information-theoretic penalty that reduces repetition without sacrificing model capability.

items.title_zh: ChannelFlow-Tools：面向三维障碍通道流ML数据集的配置驱动生成流水线
items.title_en: ChannelFlow-Tools: A Configuration-Driven Pipeline for Generating Machine-Learning-Ready Datasets of 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
items.summary_zh: 数据驱动的代理模型在计算流体力学中应用越来越广泛，其可靠性高度依赖于训练数据质量，而现有模型通常使用固定的预生成数据集。为了实现系统性的代理模型研究，需要受控的数据生成机制，使数据集能够按照具体研究需求重新生成、调整或扩展。为此，本文提出ChannelFlow-Tools，一个开源、配置驱动的流水线，用于生成三维障碍通道流动的机器学习就绪数据集。该工具支持灵活的数据定制，有助于提高计算流体力学代理模型研究的可重复性和可比性。它为数据驱动CFD研究提供了标准化且可扩展的数据基础设施。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.15236v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Data-driven surrogate models are increasingly used in computational fluid dynamics, and their reliability depends on the quality of the training data. These models are typically trained on fixed, pre-generated datasets. Systematic surrogate studies require controlled data generation, in which datasets can be regenerated, adapted, or extended to match specific research requirements. We introduce ChannelFlow-Tools, an open-source, configuration-driven pipeline for generating ML-ready datasets of three-dimensional obstructed channel flows.…
items.why_zh: 为CFD代理模型研究提供了灵活配置的数据集生成工具，提升可复现性。
items.why_en: Enables controlled, configurable dataset generation for CFD surrogate modeling, improving reproducibility.

items.title_zh: Eigenius：具有认知分层和制度中介推理的类型化知识图谱数据库系统
items.title_en: Eigenius: A Typed Knowledge-Graph DBMS with Epistemic Stratification and Institution-Mediated Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 随着通过模型上下文协议（MCP）驱动研究的“AI科学家”不断涌现，依赖临时脚本的数据处理方式将难以胜任。大规模有状态、相互关联的证据需要一种具有机器可遍历保证的专门数据库架构。Eigenius正是一个开源、类型化知识图谱数据库管理系统，其设计理念是将类型系统、存储引擎与集成协议紧密耦合，以统一内核回答“你知道什么？你的保证是什么？”这一审计问题。这种架构为AI科学研究提供了可追溯、可验证的知识支撑。Eigenius为AI驱动的科研自动化奠定了数据基础设施。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.04457v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: As "AI Scientists" emerge to drive research via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), systems relying on ephemeral scripts will fail. The sheer scale of stateful, interconnected evidence requires a machine-walkable warranty grounded in a purpose-built database architecture. Eigenius is an open-source, typed knowledge-graph DBMS built on a single premise: answering the audit question ("what do you know, and what is your warranty?") requires a unified kernel. By tightly coupling the type system, storage engine, and integration protocol, Eigen…
items.why_zh: 为AI科学家提供可审计的知识图谱数据库，支撑大规模有状态证据管理。
items.why_en: Provides an auditable knowledge-graph DBMS essential for AI-driven research at scale.

items.title_zh: 随机初始化自编码器：不动点与混沌边缘
items.title_en: Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos
items.summary_zh: 自编码器是一类特殊的深度神经网络，其性能可通过不动点来表征。该研究从这一视角出发，探讨自编码器不动点的存在性、稳定性及其吸引域，并借助收缩性质与深度神经网络中的“混沌边缘”（edge-of-chaos）概念建立联系。混沌边缘是描述网络信号传播从有序到混沌过渡的临界状态，对理解网络可训练性具有重要意义。研究表明，随机初始化的自编码器行为与这一临界状态密切相关。该工作从非线性动力学角度深化了对自编码器表示学习和泛化能力的理解。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14638v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos. Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a…
items.why_zh: 从动力学角度连接自编码器不动点与混沌边缘，深化对深度网络的理解。
items.why_en: Connects autoencoder fixed points with edge-of-chaos, deepening understanding of DNN dynamics.

items.title_zh: 利用上下文学习评估建筑环境对行动不便老年人社区步行性感知的影响
items.title_en: In-Context Learning to Assess Built Environment Impacts on Perceived Neighborhood Walkability Among Mobility-impaired Older Adults
items.summary_zh: 随着全球人口老龄化，通过包容性城市设计提升社区步行性，对缓解建筑环境障碍、促进老年人身体活动和社会参与具有重要意义。该研究利用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN，采用上下文学习（ICL）方法，分析建筑环境特征如何影响行动不便老年人对步行性的感知，数据来自社区环境步行性量表（NEWS-A）调查，样本量为257人。这一小规模数据集结合ICL，为构建老年友好社区提供了数据驱动的新思路。研究展示了机器学习在评估城市设计对弱势群体影响中的应用潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As global populations age, enhancing neighborhood walkability through inclusive urban design is important for mitigating built environment (BE) barriers that discourage physical activity and social participation among older adults. This study investigates the utility of in-context learning (ICL), using the transformer-based foundation model TabPFN, to determine how BE features influence perceived walkability, as measured by the Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale (NEWS-A) survey. Using a small-scale dataset (N = 257) comprising a unique de…
items.why_zh: 展示了上下文学习在小样本城市研究中的价值，助力老年友好社区规划。
items.why_en: Demonstrates in-context learning's value for small-sample urban design, supporting age-friendly neighborhoods.

items.title_zh: 1/2-Tsallis-INF算法是否同样适用于最佳臂识别？
items.title_en: Does 1/2-Tsallis-INF Also Work Well for Best-Arm Identification?
items.summary_zh: 多臂老虎机中遗憾最小化与最佳臂识别是两大核心目标。1/2-Tsallis-INF 是一种典型的两全其美 FTRL 算法：在随机老虎机中达到对数伪遗憾，在对抗老虎机中保持极小极大最优遗憾，且无需提前知晓环境。一个自然的问题是，同一算法在无需额外探索的情况下，是否也能可靠地识别最佳臂？本文针对这一开放问题，在随机老虎机设定下进行了研究，为算法在最佳臂识别任务中的表现提供了分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Regret minimization (RM) and best-arm identification (BAI) are two fundamental objectives in multi-armed bandits. Among regret-minimizing algorithms, $1/2$-Tsallis-INF is a canonical best-of-both-worlds FTRL algorithm: it achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic bandits while retaining minimax-optimal regret in adversarial bandits, without knowing the environment in advance. This raises a natural question: can the same algorithm, without additional exploration, also identify the best arm reliably? We study this question in stochastic band…
items.why_zh: 该研究将高效的遗憾最小化算法扩展到最佳臂识别任务，可能统一两类目标，减少对专门探索策略的需求。
items.why_en: This work extends a regret-optimal algorithm to best-arm identification, potentially unifying two fundamental bandit objectives without extra exploration.

items.title_zh: 有保证的自适应模态获取：当策略选择其自身的校准组时
items.title_en: Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group
items.summary_zh: 多模态系统在推理初期可能仅持有部分输入，获取其余输入需要成本。在自适应获取中，策略控制最终观测到的输入，因此保证需针对最终输入模式给出。传统条件校准假设分组映射与校准样本无关，但策略诱导的分组并不满足这一假设。本文刻画了模式条件保证仍然成立的条件，并给出了两种有限样本构造（包括无阈值路由方法），为自适应多模态推理提供了有效的预测保证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing w…
items.why_zh: 为带成本的自适应多模态推理提供了条件校准保证，解决了策略诱导分组带来的统计有效性难题。
items.why_en: Provides valid conditional calibration guarantees for cost-aware adaptive multimodal inference, addressing the challenge of policy-induced grouping.

items.title_zh: 稀疏原型编码是跨模态分类与预测的共同基础
items.title_en: Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities
items.summary_zh: 神经表示已成为研究现代AI模型内部机制的重要工具，但其复杂的高维结构难以解释。该研究表明，在视觉、音频和语言处理的最先进模型中，分类任务产生一种通用的表示几何。关键发现是类内变异性在表示空间中并非随机，其与分类器相关的成分与该类自身的中心存在强烈且结构化的相关性，形成一种稀疏原型编码。这一发现揭示了跨模态分类与预测背后的统一表征原则，有助于提升模型的可解释性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own cent…
items.why_zh: 揭示了跨模态模型中通用的稀疏原型表征结构，为理解深度网络内部机制提供了新视角。
items.why_en: Reveals a universal sparse prototype representation across modalities, offering new insights into the internal mechanisms of deep networks.

items.title_zh: 稀疏协作推理的隐私研究
items.title_en: A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference
items.summary_zh: 协作推理将深度模型拆分到边缘设备与服务器，客户端传输中间激活值，服务器完成剩余计算。这一过程面临通信成本高和输入隐私泄露风险。近期工作通过激活稀疏化和熵编码来降低通信成本，并直觉认为传输更少的值可以增强隐私。这篇论文对这一假设进行了实证检验，考察稀疏化在协作推理中对隐私保护的实际效果。结果将有助于在通信效率与隐私保护之间做出权衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test…
items.why_zh: 首次系统检验了“稀疏化即隐私”这一常见假设，为协作推理的通信与隐私权衡提供依据。
items.why_en: Systematically tests the common assumption that sparsity improves privacy, informing the communication-privacy trade-off in collaborative inference.

items.title_zh: 推进开放可复现的关系学习：RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel 与 RPI
items.title_en: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$\alpha$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
items.summary_zh: Prior Labs发布了其在关系学习领域的首批开源成果，包括三个软件组件：RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel和RPI。此次Alpha版本的发布旨在推动关系学习研究走向可复现和实际应用。由于涉及的工具和任务仍处于早期阶段，目前主要面向研究人员和早期实践者。开发团队表示将根据社区反馈继续完善，并期望通过开源协作加速该领域的发展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $\alpha$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the commu…
items.why_zh: 为关系学习社区提供了急需的开源基础设施和基准，有助于提高研究的可复现性和实际可用性。
items.why_en: Provides much-needed open-source infrastructure and benchmarks for relational learning, improving reproducibility and real-world usability.

items.title_zh: 带记忆的广义线性老虎机
items.title_en: Generalized Linear Bandits with Memory
items.summary_zh: 本文研究带记忆的广义线性老虎机，这是一种内生非平稳环境，奖励通过有限记忆矩阵受历史动作影响。作者指出，先前针对线性模型已知的 ~O(T^{3/4}) 遗憾界源于松散的分析，并在线性情形下通过更精细的分析恢复了 ~O(√T) 的最优遗憾率。进一步，他们将这一改进推广到广义线性模型，并提出一种基于收缩置信区间的分块算法，为带记忆的动态决策提供了更优的遗憾保证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15848v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study generalized linear bandits with memory, an endogenous non-stationary setting in which rewards depend on past actions through a finite memory matrix. Building on prior work for linear models (Clerici et al., 2024), we show that the previously known $\tilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ regret bound stems from a loose analysis, and we provide a sharpened analysis that recovers a $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret rate in the linear case. We then extend this improvement to generalized linear models and propose a block-wise algorithm based on shrunken confidence…
items.why_zh: 显著改进了带记忆bandit的遗憾界，为动态决策和非平稳环境提供了更高效的理论保证。
items.why_en: Significantly improves regret bounds for bandits with memory, offering tighter theoretical guarantees for non-stationary decision-making.

items.title_zh: 自动化学习者评估：基于EEG的熟悉度预测中机器学习和深度学习模型的基准测试
items.title_en: Automating Learner Assessment: Benchmarking Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for EEG-Based Familiarity Prediction
items.summary_zh: 学习效果的客观评估一直是教育领域的根本挑战。脑电图（EEG）提供了一种直接、非侵入的方式观察知识获取的神经关联，包括认知熟悉度。这项研究对十五种机器学习和深度学习模型进行了基准测试，用于基于EEG的熟悉度预测，覆盖面孔（事实性知识）和数学方程（概念性知识）两个认知领域。研究利用23名参与者的连续EEG数据，提取功率谱等光谱特征进行模型评估。该工作为自动化学习者评估提供了系统性的模型对比基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16541v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Objective assessment of learning remains a fundamental challenge in education. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a direct, non-invasive window into the neural correlates of knowledge acquisition, including cognitive familiarity. This study benchmarks fifteen machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for EEG-based familiarity prediction across two cognitive domains: faces (factual knowledge) and mathematical equations (conceptual knowledge). Using continuous EEG data from 23 participants, we extract spectral features (Power Spectra…
items.why_zh: 为基于EEG的学习评估提供了大规模模型基准，有助于推动教育科技中的客观、自动化评估工具发展。
items.why_en: Provides a comprehensive model benchmark for EEG-based learning assessment, advancing objective and automated evaluation tools in education technology.

items.title_zh: 鲁棒隐私：通过认证鲁棒性实现推理阶段隐私
items.title_en: Robust Privacy: Inference-Stage Privacy through Certified Robustness
items.summary_zh: 对手通过观察模型发布的预测，可以推断查询输入的敏感属性，甚至重建训练数据样本，使推理接口成为隐私泄露的侧信道。受认证鲁棒性启发，本文提出鲁棒隐私（Robust Privacy, RP），一种全新的推理阶段隐私概念：若模型在以输入x为中心、半径为R的邻域内，能够以至少1-α的置信度保证预测不变，则x享有(R, α)-鲁棒隐私。作者进一步证明了在这种保证下隐私属性成立，为推理阶段的隐私保护提供了形式化框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.17360v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An adversary observing a model's released prediction can infer sensitive attributes of the queried input, or even reconstruct representatives of the model's training data. The inference interface thus acts as a side channel for privacy leakage. We introduce Robust Privacy (RP), an inference-stage privacy notion inspired by certified robustness: if a model's prediction is provably invariant within a radius-$R$ neighborhood around an input $x$ with confidence at least $1-\alpha$, then $x$ enjoys $(R,\alpha)$-Robust Privacy, under which we prove…
items.why_zh: 首次将认证鲁棒性与推理阶段隐私结合，为防御基于推断的攻击提供了可验证的隐私保证。
items.why_en: Combines certified robustness with inference-stage privacy, offering verifiable protection against inference-based attacks.

items.title_zh: 用随机嵌入表示评估Fréchet Inception Distance的可信度
items.title_en: Evaluating the trustworthiness of the Fr\'echet Inception Distance with stochastic embedding representations
items.summary_zh: 该研究针对医学图像生成质量评估中广泛使用的Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）指标进行了可信度评估。FID依赖于InceptionV3模型在ImageNet1K自然图像上预训练所提取的特征，但这一假设在医学图像等非自然图像上可能失效。作者提出采用随机嵌入表示来评估FID的可靠性，从而更全面地理解该指标在跨领域应用中的局限性。研究结果有助于指导合成医学图像质量评估方法的选择与改进。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.21979v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Feature embeddings acquired from pretrained models are widely used in medical applications of deep learning to assess the characteristics of datasets; e.g. to determine the quality of synthetic, generated medical images. The Fr\'{e}chet Inception Distance (FID) is one popular synthetic image quality metric that relies on the assumption that the characteristic features of the data can be detected and encoded by an InceptionV3 model pretrained on ImageNet1K (natural images). While it is widely known that this makes it less effective for applica…
items.why_zh: FID是生成图像质量评估的常用指标，但其跨领域适用性存疑，本研究为其可信度提供了重要验证。
items.why_en: FID is a widely used metric for generated image quality, and this study provides crucial validation of its trustworthiness across domains.

items.title_zh: 多臂贝叶斯老虎机中的退火软贪心策略
items.title_en: Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究在具有可验证奖励的强化学习与基于群体的策略优化方法中，为何不显式建模认知不确定性的更新机制仍然有效。作者分析了一种退火软贪心策略，该策略在多臂贝叶斯老虎机中通过软max选择动作，并逐步降低温度。研究为这类不确定性无关的更新提供了理论解释，说明在众多臂的情况下，简单的贪心结合退火机制也能实现有效探索。这项工作有助于理解大语言模型策略优化中常用更新方式的原理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.31034v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and group-based policy optimization methods update a stochastic policy by sampling multiple completions per prompt and increasing the policy's probability on those with higher reward. These updates, unline the exploration mechanism in Thompson sampling and UCB, do not include explicit mechanisms that track epistemic uncertainty. This paper studies a stylized explanation for why such uncertainty-agnostic updates can nevertheless be effective. We analyze an annealed softmax policy that selects acti…
items.why_zh: 该研究为强化学习与LLM策略优化中常见的简单更新提供了理论支撑，有助于理解其有效性来源。
items.why_en: It provides theoretical justification for simple uncertainty-agnostic updates commonly used in RL and LLM policy optimization.

items.title_zh: SCPP：用于软聚类的统一Python库
items.title_en: SCPP: A Unified Python Library for Soft Clustering
items.summary_zh: SCPP是一个开源的Python软聚类框架，提供与scikit-learn兼容的规范估计器接口，统一了模糊聚类、概率聚类、图聚类、矩阵分解和深度学习等异构方法的训练、预测、成员表示、评估与基准测试流程。目前该框架集成了40种代表性算法，并附带全面的基准测试。该库旨在降低软聚类方法的使用门槛，促进不同算法间的公平比较与复现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.19620v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we present SCPP (Soft Clustering Python Package), an open-source Python framework for soft clustering. SCPP establishes a canonical, scikit-learn-compatible estimator interface that standardizes model training, prediction, membership representation, evaluation, and benchmarking across heterogeneous soft clustering methods, including fuzzy, probabilistic, graph-based, matrix factorization, and deep learning methods. The framework currently integrates 40 representative algorithms together with a comprehensive benchmarking compris…
items.why_zh: 软聚类方法众多但缺乏统一标准，SCPP提供了规范接口和基准，有助于社区使用与比较。
items.why_en: It standardizes soft clustering implementations and benchmarking, facilitating fair comparison and adoption.

items.title_zh: ODTlearn：用于预测与处方学习最优决策树的Python包
items.title_en: ODTlearn: A Package for Learning Optimal Decision Trees for Prediction and Prescription
items.summary_zh: ODTlearn是一个开源的Python包，基于Aghaei等人（2025）提出的混合整数优化（MIO）框架，用于学习高风险预测与处方任务中的最优决策树。当前版本实现了最优分类树、最优公平分类树、从观测数据学习最优处方树，以及对分布偏移鲁棒的最优分类树。该包设计旨在让研究者能够便捷地使用这些先进方法，并通过MIO保证解的全局最优性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2307.15691v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: ODTlearn is an open source Python package that provides methods for learning optimal decision trees for high-stakes predictive and prescriptive tasks based on the state-of-the-art mixed-integer optimization (MIO) framework proposed in Aghaei et al. (2025). The current version of the package provides implementations for learning optimal classification trees, optimal fair classification trees, optimal prescriptive trees from observational data, and optimal classification trees robust to distribution shifts. We have designed the package to…
items.why_zh: 该包将前沿的最优决策树方法实用化，对高风险决策场景具有重要价值。
items.why_en: It makes state-of-the-art optimal decision tree methods accessible for high-stakes decision-making.

items.title_zh: MiDAS：机器人辅助微创手术的多模态数据采集系统与数据集
items.title_en: MiDAS: A Multimodal Data Acquisition System and Dataset for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
items.summary_zh: MiDAS是一个开源、平台无关的系统，用于机器人辅助微创手术（RMIS）的多模态数据采集，解决了专有机器人遥测数据难以获取的问题。该系统集成电磁与RGB-D手部追踪、脚踏板感知和手术视频采集，无需依赖专有机器人接口，并在开源平台上进行了验证。MiDAS能够实现时间同步的多模态数据收集，为RMIS研究提供宝贵的数据资源，有望推动该领域的发展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.12407v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Background: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RMIS) research increasingly relies on multimodal data, yet access to proprietary robot telemetry remains a major barrier. We introduce MiDAS, an open-source, platform-agnostic system enabling time-synchronized, non-invasive multimodal data acquisition across surgical robotic platforms. Methods: MiDAS integrates electromagnetic and RGB-D hand tracking, foot pedal sensing, and surgical video capturing without requiring proprietary robot interfaces. We validated MiDAS on the open-sourc…
items.why_zh: 该工作突破了手术机器人数据获取壁垒，为多模态手术AI研究提供了基础设施。
items.why_en: It removes barriers to accessing surgical robot data, enabling multimodal AI research in surgery.

items.title_zh: 生物成像深度学习：我们真正学到了什么？
items.title_en: Deep Learning for BioImaging: What Are We Really Learning?
items.summary_zh: 该研究系统性地探讨了在显微镜成像中，表示学习方法究竟学到了什么。与自然图像不同，现有模型可能无法获取高层次语义特征。作者针对细胞培养和组织成像这两种最广泛使用的显微镜数据类型进行了研究，考察现有模型是否未能有效学习语义表征。研究结果揭示了表示学习在生物成像中的局限性，为开发更适合显微图像的深度学习模型提供了方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.13377v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Representation learning has driven major advances in natural image analysis by enabling models to acquire high-level semantic features. In microscopy imaging, however, it remains unclear what current representation learning methods really learn. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of representation learning for the two most widely used and broadly available microscopy data types, representing critical scales in biology: cell culture and tissue imaging. We investigate whether, in contrast to natural images, existing models fail t…
items.why_zh: 该研究指出了表示学习在生物成像中的潜在失效，对领域模型设计具有重要警示意义。
items.why_en: It highlights potential failures of representation learning in microscopy, guiding better model design for bioimaging.

items.title_zh: MoRFI：单调稀疏自编码器特征识别
items.title_en: MoRFI: Monotonic Sparse Autoencoder Feature Identification
items.summary_zh: MoRFI研究大语言模型（LLM）在微调过程中出现幻觉的机制。LLM在预训练阶段通过下一词预测获取事实知识，而后续微调可能引入参数之外的新事实，导致幻觉。作者通过受控的微调实验（聚焦于闭卷问答）识别出因果相关的潜在方向，并提出了单调稀疏自编码器特征识别方法，用于追踪这些方向的演变。这一工作为理解与缓解LLM幻觉提供了新的分析工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.26866v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire most of their factual knowledge during the pre-training stage, through next token prediction. Subsequent stages of post-training often introduce new facts outwith the parametric knowledge, giving rise to hallucinations. While it has been demonstrated that supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on new knowledge may exacerbate the problem, the underlying mechanisms are still poorly understood. We conduct a controlled fine-tuning experiment, focusing on closed-book QA, and identify latent directions causally impl…
items.why_zh: 该研究深入剖析了LLM微调导致幻觉的内在机制，为缓解幻觉提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It reveals inner mechanisms of fine-tuning-induced hallucination in LLMs, offering new directions for mitigation.

items.title_zh: 少参数更新下线性上下文老虎机的实用最优算法
items.title_en: Practical and Optimal Algorithm for Linear Contextual Bandits with Rare Parameter Updates
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究在参数更新次数受限的情况下如何解决线性上下文老虎机问题。与许多严格批处理的方法不同，学习器在区间内仍然可以实时观察上下文并顺序选择动作，只是不能在区间内频繁更新参数。作者提出了一种实用且最优的算法，并澄清了文献中“批处理”概念常被混淆的区别。该研究为真实场景中计算或通信资源受限的在线决策提供了理论保障。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.00984v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study linear contextual bandits under rare parameter updates: the learner may incorporate reward feedback into its parameter estimate only at a small number of update times, while still observing contexts online and selecting actions sequentially. This viewpoint clarifies a practical distinction that is often blurred in the literature: many "strictly batched" methods additionally restrict within-interval context adaptivity, meaning that the action rule inside an interval cannot depend on the sequence of realized contexts/actions in t…
items.why_zh: 该工作为资源受限情况下的在线决策提供了高效算法，并厘清了批处理设置的关键区别。
items.why_en: It provides an optimal algorithm for online decision-making under rare parameter updates and clarifies an important distinction in batch bandit settings.

items.title_zh: PureTD：无需评估时搜索的西洋双陆棋金钱游戏强化学习
items.title_en: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
items.summary_zh: 新论文PureTD重新审视了Tesauro的TD-Gammon，在无评估时搜索的设置下研究西洋双陆棋金钱游戏。模型通过自对弈强化学习从零学习棋子走法和加倍骰子动作，仅需少量手工编码逻辑，无需专家特征。实验结果显示，纯自对弈RL足以训练出接近当前最先进水平的模型。在带加倍骰子的金钱游戏中，该无搜索模型评估速度更快，且明显强于开源引擎。这一成果为简化强化学习游戏智能提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source engine…
items.why_zh: 该研究证明纯自对弈强化学习无需评估搜索即可达到接近顶尖的棋力，挑战了搜索在博弈智能中的必要性。
items.why_en: This work demonstrates that pure self-play RL can reach near-state-of-the-art strength without search, challenging the necessity of evaluation-time search.

items.title_zh: FactReview：基于证据的同行评审与执行式声明验证
items.title_en: FactReview: Evidence-Grounded Peer Review with Execution-Based Claim Verification
items.summary_zh: 论文提出FactReview，一个用于学术审稿的审计管道。针对现有LLM审稿系统孤立评估稿件、难以验证依赖文献和代码的声明的问题，FactReview提取审稿相关声明，在相关工作与参考文献中寻找依据，并在代码可用时在固定修复预算下执行发布工件。在26篇论文分离的测试论文上，包含354个经人工验证的声明，FactReview的声明恢复F1值达到84.3%。该研究为提升AI审稿的可靠性和可验证性提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.04074v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based reviewing systems typically assess manuscripts in isolation, leaving literature- and code-dependent claims difficult to verify. We present FactReview, an audit pipeline that extracts review-relevant claims, grounds them in related work and reference checks, and, when code is available, executes released artifacts under a fixed repair budget. On 26 paper-disjoint test papers with 354 human-verified claims, FactReview achieves 84.3\% F1 for claim recovery. In a same-backend, evidence-matched comparison, Fa…
items.why_zh: 该研究通过证据锚定与代码执行验证，解决了LLM审稿中文献和代码相关声明难以核实的问题，提升审稿可信度。
items.why_en: By grounding claims in evidence and executing code, FactReview addresses the verification gap in LLM-based reviewing, enhancing trustworthiness.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 预告 Claude Code 将整合 /design 命令

items.title_zh: OpenAI 回应少量 Codex 用户调用 GPT-5.6 系列 AI 模型误删文件问题
items.title_en: OpenAI Responds to Codex File Deletion Issue, Adds Multi-Layered Safeguards
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，OpenAI Codex 团队负责人蒂博 · 索蒂奥（Thibault Sottiaux）今天在 X 平台发布长推文， 回应在 Codex 中调用 GPT-5.6 系列模型后，误删部分用户文件问题。 索蒂奥表示自几周前开始陆续收到少量 Codex 用户反馈，在 Codex 中使用 GPT-5.6 系列模型后，在执行了用户未授权的破坏性操作。 OpenAI 发现本应清理临时文件的命令却误删了用户文件。 其中一种情况是，Codex 会在临时工作中重用 $HOME 等系统环境变量。这样一来，错误的清理命令可能会指向实际的用户主目录。有些情况下，模型会尝试删除或覆盖临时路径，而没有检查该路径中已存在的内容。IT之家附上相关截图如下： 索蒂奥对此回应表示已添加多层保护措施： Codex 现在被明确指示在执行操作之前检查删除目标，创建新的临时目录，避免重新利用系统环境变量，优先执行可恢复的操作，并在范围不明确时停止操作。 OpenAI 加强了执行检查，增强识别高风险删除命令，并上报审核。如果命令被拒绝，模型将采取更安全的方法。 OpenAI 提高了意外启用完全访问权限的难度，增加了更清晰的警告，并进一步限制了特别危险的权限组合。 OpenAI 更新了自动审核功能，以便更好地识别破坏性行为。 OpenAI 构建了针对性评估模型，用于重现我们观察到的失败案例。此外，…
items.summary_en: OpenAI Codex team lead Thibault Sottiaux addressed reports of GPT-5.6 models accidentally deleting user files. The issue stemmed from cleanup commands reusing system environment variables like $HOME, leading to unintended deletions. OpenAI has added multiple safeguards, including pre-deletion checks, new temp directories, safer execution policies, and enhanced review mechanisms.
items.why_zh: 这是少见的AI代理造成实际数据损失的公开案例，凸显智能体工具在权限管理和安全执行方面的关键挑战。
items.why_en: This rare public case of an AI agent causing data loss highlights critical challenges in permission management and safe execution for agentic tools.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息， 宇树科技今日登陆科创板正式挂牌交易 ，开盘大涨最高 629.44%，股价最高报 1,100 元。截至IT之家发文，宇树科技股价涨近 500%，市值超 3,600 亿元。 据第一财经报道，招股书显示，宇树科技董事长、总经理兼首席技术官王兴兴直接持有公司 8,671.4964 万股股份，发行后占公司股本总额的 21.4395%。王兴兴发行前还通过股权激励平台上海宇翼间接持有公司股份比例 9.5367%。算下来，其直接与间接合计持有公司股份比例约在 30% 上下， 所持市值超千亿元，拿下“90 后”首富 。 据 2025 年《新财富杂志》发布的 90 后企业家名单，影石创新创始人刘靖康以 202 亿元身家拿下 90 后首富。 另据中新经纬报道，DeepSeek 创始人梁文锋旗下深度求索、幻方量化和九章资产通过战略配售、网下打新合计获配约 119.16 万股，以发行价计算，梁文锋打新宇树科技最高浮盈超 11 亿元（以每股最高 1,100 元计算）。雷军创办的顺为资本关联方 Astrend IV 持有 1610.6 万股，最高浮盈超 152 亿元。
items.summary_en: Unitree Technology made a strong stock market debut on the STAR Market on Aug 19, with shares surging up to 629.44% intraday and market cap surpassing 360 billion RMB. Founder Wang Xingxing's stake is now worth over 100 billion RMB, making him the wealthiest entrepreneur born after 1990. Other investors, including Liang Wenfeng's funds and Shunwei Capital's affiliate, also saw large gains.

items.title_zh: 因隐私担忧，美国移民与海关执法局禁止员工佩戴 Meta 智能眼镜
items.title_en: ICE Bans Employees from Wearing Meta Smart Glasses Over Privacy Concerns
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）已禁止员工佩戴 Meta 智能眼镜。出于隐私方面的担忧，越来越多工作场所开始禁止使用这类设备。 ICE 当地时间周二在一份政策备忘录中表示，考虑到 Meta 智能眼镜可以隐蔽地录制视频和音频，该机构将其视为一种可穿戴摄像设备。因此，“使用 Meta 眼镜或类似设备可能会在无意中捕捉、记录或传输敏感信息，从而可能损害隐私以及法律赋予的保护”，ICE 代理局长 David Venturella 在备忘录中写道。 根据这项政策，ICE 员工不得在“联邦工作场所”佩戴 Meta 智能眼镜。ICE 表示，这项规定适用于所有员工，而不仅仅是执法人员。 美国国土安全部发言人在一份声明中表示：“员工私自拥有的可穿戴摄像设备以及未经授权的录音一直都是被禁止的。” 越来越多机构和工作场所开始禁止 Meta 智能眼镜。这款产品已经成为 Meta 最畅销的硬件产品之一，但与此同时，它也持续引发隐私和监控方面的担忧。 Meta 于 2021 年推出智能眼镜，此后与雷朋（Ray-Ban）、Oakley 等品牌合作推出了多个版本。 这款眼镜在镜框靠近眼睛的位置上方配备了一枚小型摄像头，可以录制视频和音频。设备开始录制时，会亮起一颗闪烁的白色指示灯。新版本还配备了 AI 助手，可以响应用户的语音指令，并能够在镜框边缘投射一个只有佩戴者才能看到的微型屏幕…
items.summary_en: ICE has prohibited its employees from wearing Meta smart glasses at federal workplaces, citing the risk of covert audio/video recording and exposure of sensitive information. The ban applies to all staff, reflecting growing privacy concerns about such wearables.
items.why_zh: 政府机构对智能可穿戴设备的禁令凸显了隐私保护与消费科技普及之间的冲突。
items.why_en: The ban underscores privacy risks associated with AI-powered wearable devices in sensitive work environments.

items.title_zh: 微软 Copilot AI 漏洞被披露：恶意链接绕过用户确认窃取隐私数据
items.title_en: Microsoft Copilot AI Vulnerability Disclosed: Malicious Links Bypass User Confirmation to Steal Private Data
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，科技媒体 Ars Technica 昨日（8 月 18 日）发布博文，报道称微软 Copilot 存在安全漏洞， 可以通过 ?autorun=1 参数，配合 ?q= 绕过用户确认，从而窃取用户信息。 IT之家援引博文介绍，安全公司 Varonis 研究人员指出和多数 AI 助手一样，Copilot 支持通过 URL 接收提示词。URL 的基础部分可让模型打开 Gmail 等应用，后续参数和文本则能要求助手总结收件箱内容或起草邮件。 研究人员发现 Copilot 存在?autorun=1 参数，配合?q= 绕过用户确认，构造出如下链接： https://copilot.microsoft.com/?q=&autorun=1 用户点击攻击者制作的链接后，浏览器会在用户已登录的会话中加载 Copilot，其中?autorun=1 会触发自动执行，?q= 中的提示词则无需用户手势即可运行。 研究人员构造的提示词要求 Copilot 搜索收件箱，找出最新收到的邮件，仅提取发件人的电子邮件地址，并将结果保存到名为 SUPPORT 的变量中。随后，Copilot 会生成以下 URL，并执行“总结 URL”的命令： https://webhook.site/75aabb18-9bcf-4383-9e29-349fbc4c40e8/SUPPORT 攻击者就能把恶意链接…
items.summary_en: Security firm Varonis revealed a vulnerability in Microsoft Copilot that lets attackers bypass user confirmation using crafted URLs with ?autorun=1 and ?q= parameters. Clicking a malicious link can trigger automatic actions that exfiltrate sensitive data to attacker-controlled webhooks. This poses a serious privacy risk.
items.why_zh: 作为广泛使用的AI助手，Copilot的漏洞可能令大量用户的隐私数据面临被窃取风险。
items.why_en: As a widely used AI assistant, Copilot's vulnerability could put a large number of users at risk of privacy data theft.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 二季度营收 67 亿美元环比增 18%，被 Anthropic 营收反超且亏损持续扩大
items.title_en: OpenAI Q2 Revenue Hits $6.7B, Up 18% QoQ; Anthropic Surpasses as Losses Widen
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI 告诉投资者，公司第二季度营收较第一季度增长 18%，但亏损进一步扩大。这一结果令部分股东感到失望，因为他们原本希望这家初创公司能够进一步缩小与竞争对手 Anthropic 之间的差距。 知情人士透露，在截至 6 月的三个月里，OpenAI 营收从第一季度的 57 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 385.14 亿元人民币） 增至 67 亿美元 （现汇率约合 452.71 亿元人民币） 。不过，公司的营业利润率进一步陷入负值，距离实现盈利越来越远，而市场一直期待 OpenAI 能够在不久后启动备受关注的首次公开募股（IPO）。 同期，Anthropic 的营收增长了一倍多，达到 116 亿美元 （现汇率约合 783.8 亿元人民币） 。这也是 Anthropic 的营收首次超过成立时间更早的 OpenAI。与此同时，Anthropic 还实现了小幅营业利润。 两家公司的不同表现，凸显出自今年年初以来，人工智能行业的竞争格局发生了多么剧烈的变化。ChatGPT 用户增长放缓，再加上 Anthropic 旗下热门编程工具 Claude Code 的成功，让 OpenAI 在竞争中逐渐处于被动地位。为扭转局面，OpenAI 不得不调整业务方向，同时对管理团队进行大幅改组。 上周，OpenAI 更换了首席营收官 Denise…
items.summary_en: OpenAI reported Q2 revenue of $6.7 billion, up 18% quarter-over-quarter, but losses widened. Meanwhile, Anthropic's revenue more than doubled to $11.6 billion, surpassing OpenAI for the first time and posting a small operating profit. The diverging performance highlights intensifying competition in AI, prompting OpenAI to restructure its management.
items.why_zh: OpenAI被Anthropic反超且亏损扩大，表明生成式AI竞争格局正发生重大变化，并可能影响其IPO前景。
items.why_en: OpenAI being surpassed by Anthropic with widening losses signals a major shift in AI competition and could affect its IPO prospects.

items.summary_en: Mozilla released Firefox 154 stable on August 18, with plans for version 155 on September 1. It introduces Smart Window suggested tab groups, NVIDIA GeForce NOW support on Windows, local profile backups on macOS, improved full-page translation, selectable app icons, and a new 'Manage AI' shortcut in the address bar.
items.why_zh: Firefox 154通过引入AI管理入口和云游戏支持，展现了浏览器在AI时代的功能演进与实用更新。
items.why_en: Firefox 154 brings AI controls and cloud gaming support, showing how browsers are adapting to the AI era.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（8 月 18 日）发布博文，报道称苹果公司最新公示 Safari 浏览器 26.6.1 更新安全日志， 共计修复 22 个涉及 WebKit 的 CVE 安全漏洞，其中 9 个是 OpenAI Codex Security 发现的，占比约为 41%。 IT之家注：OpenAI Codex Security 是一款专为工程和安全团队打造的 AI 应用程序安全智能体（Agent）。它能够深入分析项目的代码上下文与威胁模型，自动检测、验证并修复复杂的代码安全漏洞，旨在大幅降低误报率并减轻安全警报带来的工作负担。 其他贡献者来自 Out of Bounds、Cisco Talos、Citadelo、TrendAI Zero Day Initiative、 Calif.io 、Braze Security Team 等组织或团队。 在修复内容方面，包含攻击者通过恶意构造的网页内容触发 Safari 意外崩溃、导致相关进程崩溃或终止，以及造成内存破坏。 公告还列出 2 个明确可能导致内存破坏的漏洞。另有 1 个 WebKit History 漏洞可能在用户访问恶意网站时泄露敏感数据。
items.summary_en: Apple's Safari 26.6.1 update patches 22 WebKit CVEs, with 9 discovered by OpenAI Codex Security, about 41%. The fixes address issues like crashes, memory corruption, and sensitive data disclosure via malicious web content.
items.why_zh: 苹果采用AI安全智能体发现漏洞，展示了AI在网络安全领域日益重要的角色。
items.why_en: Apple's use of an AI agent to discover vulnerabilities highlights the growing role of AI in cybersecurity.

items.title_zh: 入侵 Hugging Face 事件后，OpenAI 放缓模型训练并加强安全监控
items.title_en: OpenAI slows model training and boosts security monitoring after Hugging Face incident
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，当地时间周二，OpenAI 宣布了一批新的安全政策，重点是控制模型在测试期间可能发生的安全事件。新的安全措施包括在模型开发过程中进行更加细致的监控，同时在训练后阶段进一步加强对模型对齐和安全性的重视。 IT之家注意到，OpenAI 在一篇博客文章中表示：“随着模型能力不断增强，在内部开发和测试这些模型过程中所面临的风险也在增加。我们在监控、对齐和安全方面制定的标准必须始终领先于这些风险。” 这是 OpenAI 自 7 月 21 日披露 Hugging Face 事件以来，在安全实践方面首次对外公布的重大调整之一。 OpenAI 代表表示，这些措施并不是直接针对 Hugging Face 事件推出的，但即将推出的 Astra 模型所展现出的网络安全能力，以及整个 AI 行业快速发展的步伐，也是促使公司采取这些措施的部分原因。 OpenAI 同时透露，在 Hugging Face 事件发生后，公司曾暂停强化学习（RL）训练两周，但目前已经重新启动了许多风险较低模型的训练工作。 OpenAI 在博客中写道：“我们目前仍暂停规模最大的前沿强化学习训练计划，同时开展小规模训练和评估，以评估模型行为、验证安全措施，并在继续推进之前获得更多有关模型对齐情况的证据。” OpenAI 研究副总裁 Amelia Glaese 在接受记者采访时强调，随着模型能力不断增强，…
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced new safety policies on Tuesday to strengthen monitoring, alignment, and security during model training and testing, following the Hugging Face incident disclosed on July 21. The company said it paused reinforcement learning (RL) training for two weeks and has only resumed training on lower-risk models; its largest frontier RL training program remains paused while small-scale training and evaluations are conducted. OpenAI noted the changes are not directly a response to the incident but also reflect the cybersecurity capabilities of its upcoming Astra model and the rapid pace of AI industry development.
items.why_zh: 这是 OpenAI 在经历安全事件后首次大幅调整训练流程，反映前沿 AI 公司在能力竞赛中对安全与风险管控的优先级提升。
items.why_en: This marks OpenAI's first major safety-practice overhaul after a security incident, showing that cutting-edge AI labs are prioritizing risk management amid the race for more capable models.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 AI 文本水印后，各类去水印工具开始涌现
items.title_en: AI text watermark removers emerge after Anthropic introduces watermarking
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，Anthropic 希望让 AI 生成的文本更容易被识别，但一些软件开发者已经开始开发专门用于消除这些标记的工具。 这家 AI 公司上周表示，部分 Claude 模型生成的文本会带有一种“不可感知的水印”。由于这种水印是通过 Claude 的选词方式形成的统计模式，因此即使用户复制粘贴文本，水印也会随之保留下来。 一些人认为，AI 水印能够提高内容透明度，是一项值得欢迎的举措。不过，这一做法也引发了科技行业从业者的担忧：即使用户只是利用 Claude 对文本进行校对、翻译或总结，相关标记也可能跟随最终内容一起传播。此前就有一些用户告诉 Business Insider，他们因此取消了 Claude 的订阅。 这种反弹也促使一些人开始寻找绕过水印的方法。在美国，Google Trends 上“AI watermark remover”（AI 水印移除工具）的搜索热度环比上涨了 60%。一些开发者和创业者甚至开始自己动手开发工具，用于从文本和文件中移除 AI 水印。 Anthropic 表示，引入水印是为了履行其在欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）下的相关承诺。 “这是对真实问题的错误解决方案” IT之家注意到，来自巴黎的科技创业者、AI 电商工具 Memo 创始人 Guillaume Meyer，在 Anthropic 宣布相关计划几天后，就发布了一…
items.summary_en: Anthropic introduced an imperceptible watermark on text generated by some Claude models, based on statistical patterns in word choice that persist even after copy-pasting. While aimed at increasing AI transparency and meeting EU AI Act commitments, the move has sparked concerns and led to a 60% surge in U.S. Google searches for 'AI watermark remover', with developers already creating tools to strip the watermark.
items.why_zh: 该事件凸显 AI 内容可追溯性与用户隐私、工具实用性之间的张力，并可能影响 AI 文本工具的使用体验与行业标准。
items.why_en: It highlights tension between AI content traceability and user concerns over privacy and utility, potentially influencing adoption and industry standards for AI-generated text.

items.title_zh: 消息称谷歌 Googlebook 系列笔记本新品预览活动将于 9 月 15 日举行
items.title_en: Google reportedly hosting Googlebook preview event on September 15
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 19 日消息，据外媒 Chrome Unboxed 报道，谷歌已悄悄向部分媒体发出邀请，透露公司将于 9 月 15 日举办 Googlebook 新品预览活动，届时除了产品演示外，媒体还可以现场体验这些新款笔记本。 谷歌在今年 2026 年 I/O 开发者大会期间首次公布了 Googlebook 高端安卓笔记本，将由 Acer、ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo 率先推出首批高端机型。 与传统 Chromebook 不同，Googlebook 将基于 Android 技术栈打造，但 Google 目前尚未公布这一新操作系统的正式名称。此前曝光的 Googlebook 还显示，其将针对大屏幕和触控、键鼠等不同输入方式进行优化，并进一步强化 Android 应用和 Gemini 人工智能功能。 如果 9 月 15 日活动消息属实，那么 Googlebook 距离正式上市应该已经不远。按照谷歌过去的产品发布节奏，这类媒体预览活动通常会在产品正式开售前不久举行，因此 Googlebook 很可能会在今年初秋（9 月末 10 月初）正式上市。
items.summary_en: Google has reportedly sent invitations to select media for a Googlebook preview event on September 15, where attendees can try the new laptops. Googlebook, first unveiled at Google's 2026 I/O conference, is a high-end Android-based laptop set to be launched first by Acer, ASUS, Dell, HP, and Lenovo. It optimizes the Android stack for large screens and various inputs while enhancing Android app and Gemini AI features. If the event takes place, a formal release may follow soon, possibly in late September or early October.
items.why_zh: Googlebook 是谷歌在 Chromebook 之外另起炉灶的安卓高端笔记本产品线，其发布节奏和新系统细节对 Android 生态与 PC 市场格局都可能产生影响。
items.why_en: Googlebook represents Google's new premium Android-based laptop line beyond Chromebooks; its launch timing and OS details could impact the Android ecosystem and PC market.

items.summary_en: ZTO Express reported H1 FY2026 revenue of RMB 27.832 billion, up 22.5% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders rose 31.5% to RMB 5.169 billion. Parcel volume grew 9.6% and average ticket price increased 12%, lifting core express revenue by 22.8%. Operating cash flow surged 62.27% to RMB 7.353 billion, with EPS at RMB 6.71. The results beat market expectations, reflecting effective cost control and improved profitability, according to an AI analysis.
items.why_zh: 中通快递业绩超预期增长，显示快递行业在价格与成本双优化下盈利改善，为市场提供重要基本面参考。
items.why_en: ZTO's better-than-expected results highlight profitability improvements in the express delivery industry through price and cost optimization, offering a key fundamental reference.

items.summary_en: ZTO Express reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of RMB 14.55 billion, up 23% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders surged 56.7% to RMB 3.078 billion, with gross margin at 25.7%. Parcel volume grew 6.5% to 10.5 billion, 2.3 percentage points above the industry average, raising market share to 19.9%. Core express ticket revenue increased 15.5%, while operating cash flow jumped 110.48% to RMB 4.564 billion. The results beat expectations, aided by effective cost controls.

items.summary_zh: OpenAI正式发布了面向13至17岁青少年的ChatGPT服务，这是其扩大AI产品用户群体的重要动作。据ABC新闻等媒体报道，该版本配备了更强的安全保护措施，以满足青少年使用需求。OpenAI希望通过这一举措，让年轻用户能够在安全的环境中体验AI技术，同时缓解家长和教育工作者对隐私及内容安全的担忧。具体功能细节仍需进一步了解。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for teens ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
items.why_zh: 此次发布意味着AI产品正式进入青少年市场，将引发关于未成年人AI使用的广泛讨论。
items.why_en: The launch marks AI's official entry into the teen market, spurring broader discussions on minors' AI use.

items.title_zh: OpenAI面向青少年推出ChatGPT，新增安全与学习功能
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens With New Safety and Study Features
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出青少年版ChatGPT，该版本新增了安全保护和学习辅助功能。针对13至17岁用户，新版ChatGPT不仅加强了内容过滤和家长控制，还提供专注于学习的工具，帮助学生在不依赖直接答案的情况下掌握知识。这一发布体现了OpenAI在AI教育应用领域的持续布局，也回应了社会对青少年AI安全的关切。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens With New Safety and Study Features AI Insider
items.why_zh: 将安全与教育功能结合，展示了AI产品面向年轻用户的设计方向。
items.why_en: Combining safety with study features illustrates a design direction for AI products targeting young users.

items.title_zh: OpenAI面向青少年推出ChatGPT，强化安全护栏
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens With Stronger Safety Guardrails
items.summary_zh: OpenAI正式面向13至17岁青少年推出ChatGPT版本，并配备了更强的安全护栏。该版本旨在通过更严格的限制和审查机制，防止青少年接触不当内容或滥用AI工具。OpenAI表示，这些安全措施是专门为年轻用户设计的，体现了其对AI伦理和未成年人保护的重视。目前，该功能已逐步向用户开放。

items.why_zh: 强化安全护栏表明AI公司开始将未成年人保护纳入产品设计的核心考虑。
items.why_en: Stronger guardrails indicate that AI companies are putting minors' protection at the core of product design.

items.title_zh: OpenAI为青少年推出ChatGPT，加强防护与防作弊功能——15家媒体如何报道
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens With Stronger Safeguards and Anti-Cheating Features: how 15 outlets framed it
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出的青少年版ChatGPT配备了更强有力的安全防护和防作弊功能，并得到了15家媒体的广泛报道。各媒体从不同角度分析了该版本的意义，包括其在教育领域的影响、安全措施的有效性以及AI伦理问题。这一版本通过拒绝代写作业和加强内容限制，试图平衡人工智能的辅助作用与学术诚信。媒体的多角度报道也反映出公众对青少年使用AI的高度关注。

items.title_zh: 彭博：Anthropic IPO前信贷额度将超过100亿美元

items.why_en: This substantial credit line highlights strong capital market support for Anthropic ahead of its IPO, underscoring the AI investment boom.

items.why_en: Surpassing OpenAI in annualized revenue marks Anthropic as a leader in AI commercialization, making its upcoming IPO a key event.

items.title_zh: GenBio推出“虚拟细胞”AI模型
items.title_en: GenBio Launches a “Virtual Cell” AI Model
items.summary_zh: GenBio公司推出了一款名为“虚拟细胞”的AI模型。该模型旨在通过计算模拟细胞的行为与机制，可能用于生物医学研究和药物开发。借助AI技术，研究人员可以更高效地探索细胞过程，减少对物理实验的依赖，从而加速科学发现。这一创新有望在疾病机制研究、靶点筛选等方面带来突破。GenBio的举措展示了人工智能在生命科学领域的新应用，也预示未来生物学研究将更依赖计算模型。
items.summary_en: GenBio Launches a “Virtual Cell” AI Model Lifespan Research Institute
items.why_zh: “虚拟细胞”模型可能革新生物研究方式，展示了AI在生命科学领域的巨大潜力。
items.why_en: The Virtual Cell model could transform biological research, highlighting AI's vast potential in life sciences.

items.why_en: The launch of a teen-specific version shows AI companies prioritizing child safety, setting a responsible example for the industry.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出青少年版ChatGPT，同日Meta因儿童安全问题出庭

items.summary_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens — on the same day Meta goes to court over child safety The Lufkin Daily News
items.why_zh: 同日对比凸显青少年安全成为科技公司面临的核心监管与企业责任议题。
items.why_en: The simultaneous events underscore child safety as a critical regulatory and corporate responsibility issue for tech companies.

Equipped with a 1/1.3-inch sensor, it supports 4K 60fps recording and AI-assisted shooting for multiple angles, targeting travel, family, and daily vlogging scenarios.

items.why_en: The product merges a flying camera with a handheld gimbal at an accessible price, making aerial and vlog shooting more affordable and convenient.

items.title_zh: 王兴兴谈离开大疆创办宇树：从小就热爱机器人，2016 年就已预判到技术发展方向和趋势
items.title_en: Wang Xingxing on Leaving DJI to Found Unitree: A Lifelong Passion for Robotics and Early Foresight
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 18 日消息，宇树科技明日将正式在上海证券交易所科创板挂牌上市。 在 8 月 7 日的 IPO 网上路演结束后，宇树科技董事长、总经理兼首席技术官王兴兴在原定三小时的路演结束后并未离场，而是将未回答的提问逐条看完、斟酌措辞后逐字回应，又额外停留了近三个小时。上海证券报今日整理了王兴兴一系列问答。 针对 2016 年从大疆离职创业的原因，王兴兴回应称，自己从小热爱科技和机器人，2009 年读大一时就用约 200 元成本制作了第一款双足人形机器人。2016 年硕士毕业后，他短暂入职大疆，因在校期间设计的四足机器人“XDog”已获得外部投资者和客户关注，便辞职创立了宇树科技。他表示，当时机器人赛道非常冷门，但他当时就已经看到了技术发展的方向和趋势。 针对外界给宇树科技贴上的“价格屠夫”标签，王兴兴回应称：“其实我觉得我们没有做到 ' 屠夫 ' 的程度。我们的毛利总体来说是合理的。”他进一步表示，每一个真正良好发展的行业都需要有合理的利润，才能促进行业健康发展。 IT之家注意到，财务数据显示，2023 年至 2025 年，宇树科技人形机器人的毛利率分别为 87.67%、69.26% 和 63.18%。2025 年公司实现营业收入 16.99 亿元、扣非后净利润 5.9 亿元。 截至 2026 年 7 月，宇树科技双足人形机器人累计生产下线约 1.8 万台。2025 年全球…
items.summary_en: Unitree Robotics is set to list on the STAR Market. Founder Wang Xingxing stayed an extra three hours after the IPO roadshow to answer questions. He explained his decision to leave DJI in 2016, citing a lifelong passion for robotics and early foresight into the technology trend. He also addressed the 'price killer' label, stating the company's gross margins are reasonable and that healthy industries need proper profits. In 2025, Unitree achieved revenue of 1.699 billion RMB.
items.why_zh: 王兴兴的创业经历反映了风口到来前的技术预判与坚持，对理解机器人产业与资本市场动态有启示作用。
items.why_en: Wang's story highlights how foresight and persistence in robotics can lead to a successful IPO, offering insights into the industry and market.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 600亿美元收购Cursor，助力马斯克AI雄心
items.title_en: How SpaceX’s $60 Billion Cursor Acquisition Bolsters Musk’s AI Ambitions
items.summary_zh: 该报道聚焦SpaceX以600亿美元收购Cursor一事，探讨其如何服务于马斯克更宏大的AI战略。Cursor作为热门的AI编程工具，其技术能力可能被整合进SpaceX及马斯克旗下其他公司，以提升自动化研发效率。文章还分析了这一收购对AI编程赛道竞争格局的潜在冲击，以及监管层面的可能考量。总体而言，这笔交易若完成，将显著扩大马斯克在AI领域的布局，并加剧行业整合。
items.summary_en: How SpaceX’s $60 Billion Cursor Acquisition Bolsters Musk’s AI Ambitions Barron's
items.why_zh: 这笔巨额收购将强化马斯克的AI生态布局，并可能重塑AI编程工具市场竞争格局。
items.why_en: The massive deal could strengthen Musk's AI ecosystem and reshape the AI coding tool market.

items.title_zh: 百度 2026 Q2 业绩会实录：文心将重回 AI 第一梯队，年底前完成香港主要上市
items.title_en: Baidu Q2 2026 Earnings Call: ERNIE to Return to AI Top Tier, HK Primary Listing by Year-End
items.summary_zh: 百度发布 2026 年第二季度财报，季度总营收 313 亿元；百度一般性业务收入 252 亿元，其中 AI 业务收入占比 50%，已连续两季占比过半。本季度，AI 云基础设施中 GPU 云同比增长 283%，连续四个季度实现三位数增长。 财报发布后，百度董事长兼 CEO 李彦宏，移动生态事业群总裁罗戎，智能云事业群总裁沈抖，CFO 何海建等高管出席随后召开的财报电话会议，解读财报要点并回答分析师提问。 以下为本次电话会议分析师问答环节的主要内容： 摩根大通分析师 Alex Yao： 感谢管理层接受我的提问。随着数万亿参数的大模型快速涌现，不断刷新基准测试的性能上限，百度如何看待文心在此处的竞争定位？在近期引进资深基础大模型人才之后，文心的核心技术与产品重点是什么？投资者应当对它下一阶段的发展抱有怎样的预期？谢谢。 首先，从行业视角来看，基础大模型仍在快速迭代。大致每隔几个月，就会有不同模型在某些能力上取得领先。这表明该领域依旧高度变化，竞争格局远远没有尘埃落定。在这样的市场当中，我们认为长期竞争力往往归结于持续的技术投入、以应用为驱动的思路以及耐心。百度一直是一家相信技术、并且愿意对技术做长期投入的公司。过往经验反复证明，有价值的技术创新需要耐心和坚持。如今，百度很多重要的人工智能资产，包括昆仑芯以及萝卜快跑，都是超过十余年持续投入的成果。它们已经成为我们差异化竞争力的核心来源，并…
items.summary_en: Baidu's Q2 2026 revenue reached RMB 31.3 billion, with AI business accounting for 50% of general business revenue for the second straight quarter. GPU cloud revenue jumped 283% year-over-year, marking four consecutive quarters of triple-digit growth. During the earnings call, CEO Robin Li said ERNIE will return to the AI frontline, emphasizing long-term R&D and application-driven strategies, with a primary Hong Kong listing planned by year-end.
items.why_zh: 百度AI业务占比过半且GPU云高速增长，展示其AI商业化成果，香港上市计划将影响其资本布局。
items.why_en: Baidu's AI revenue share and GPU cloud growth signal strong commercialization, while its HK listing plan may reshape its capital strategy.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出青少年版ChatGPT，承诺更适龄的对话体验
items.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens, promising more age-appropriate chatbot
items.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布推出面向青少年群体的ChatGPT版本，承诺提供更适龄、更安全的聊天机器人体验。该版本可能针对青少年的使用习惯调整内容过滤和交互方式，以减少不适当信息。此举是OpenAI扩大用户覆盖的重要一步，但也引发关于青少年隐私保护和AI教育影响的热议。目前，具体功能和上线时间尚未公布，但业界普遍关注其如何平衡安全性与实用性。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens, promising more age-appropriate chatbot NBC Boston
items.why_zh: AI产品开始专门面向青少年群体，安全与教育责任将成为行业重要议题。
items.why_en: The launch marks AI's entry into younger demographics, highlighting safety and educational responsibilities.

items.title_zh: OpenAI发布带内置学习工具的青少年版ChatGPT
items.title_en: OpenAI launches "ChatGPT for Teens" with built-in study tools
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出青少年版ChatGPT，并内置学习工具，旨在为青少年提供兼具辅助学习和安全性的AI助手。该版本可能包括作业辅导、知识问答等功能，同时强化内容审核，确保适龄。这标志着AI在教育领域的应用进一步深化，但也可能引发对学术诚信和依赖性的担忧。具体的工具清单和开放范围仍有待官方揭晓。业界认为，此举将使ChatGPT在校园场景中更具竞争力。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches "ChatGPT for Teens" with built-in study tools Neowin
items.why_zh: 内置学习工具的青少年版将AI直接嵌入学习场景，可能改变教育科技格局并引发相关争议。
items.why_en: By adding study tools, OpenAI targets the education sector, potentially transforming learning while raising concerns about over-reliance.
